about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Senior Full Stack Engineer & Tech Lead based in Barranquilla, Colombia. I specialize in SaaS architecture, LLM integrations, and high-availability systems. I've led end-to-end development — from MVP to enterprise — automating $2M+ in processes and serving 200+ active users. My background spans embedded IoT, backend systems, DevOps, and applied AI, which gives me an unusually wide lens when designing solutions.

items.name: Conversational SaaS Engine
items.description: Led end-to-end development of a visual SaaS engine for omnichannel conversational flow automation (WhatsApp, SIP, Web). Orchestrated a 2-engineer team under Scrum. Integrated LLMs to reduce human intervention by 40%.

items.name: Multi-Tenant Analytics Platform
items.description: Designed the core multi-tenant architecture with real-time enterprise dashboards and zero data cross-contamination between companies. Implemented native WhatsApp Business API integrations with role-based message matrix.

items.name: IoT Cold Chain Monitoring
items.description: Designed the technical proposal and architectural blueprint for an SoC system based on ESP32-C3 for remote cold chain monitoring in pharmaceutical logistics. Defined real-time alerts and scope resulting in zero IT losses.

contact.heading: Let's Work Together
contact.subheading: Open to full-time roles and freelance projects. Whether you're building a SaaS product, integrating AI, or need a tech lead — I'd love to hear about it.
